english_sub: THE ISLAND THAT ROSE AT MIDNIGHT

topic.title: Pathiramanal: the island that rose at midnight
topic.angle: Legend: a young man dived into Vembanad lake for his evening prayers, the water parted and sand rose; hence 'Pathira-manal', midnight sand; today a bird island reached only by boat
key_facts: Pathiramanal is a small island in Vembanad lake, Alappuzha district
Legend: a young Brahmin dived into the lake for his evening prayers (sandhyavandanam), the water parted and land rose
Today it is known for resident and migratory birds and is reached only by boat
